title: Very knowledgeable and...
text: Very knowledgeable and courteous tour guide.  Emmanuel was on time and had a positive attitude. It was a pleasure meeting him.
author: Grace_M

title: Unforgettable Seville !
text: The Alcazar, The Giralda and the Cathedral are a must if you are in Seville!! Everything is so unique and it was an amazing experience, for real unforgettable! Our guide Javier was very knowledgeable and gave us a lot of information about Spain history but also he had this sense of humor that didn’t feel like a history class. We love it ! Thanks so much Javier !!
author: Jorge_M

title: Sevilla is wonderful!!
text: Extremely knowledgeable local guides with great command of the English language. Very willing to answer more in depth questions. Gave recommendations on other day activities.
author: Oscar_E

title: Great tours in Seville
text: Both the guided tour of Alcazar and the Cathedral were fabulous. Loved using the headsets so we could all hear easily. Great guides. Had some trouble finding the guides but the virtual assistant was very helpful.
author: 448kims448

title: Informative tour of the cathedral and alcazar
text: The cathedral and alcazar guided tours were very good. Suzanna who gave us  the cathedral tour was funny and very informative. Elena who provided the tour of the alcazar was very knowledgeable of Spain and Sevilla  history and made the experience very lively.
author: Sangeetha_G

title: 3 cities one day
text: Long day, but beautiful country and the 3 cities were all different.  It was a great overview of different  regions  of  Spain.   Amazing  architecture and history. Sergio, Alejandro were wonderful!  Thank you for taking care of us!
author: Jane_B

title: Must Do Great Experience with Great Guides
text: If you are going to Sevilla, you have to do this experience.  Our guides were both very professional and provided a wealth of information that we would not have otherwise known about and made sense of these historically complicated sites in a very accessible way. They were both pleasant and fun as well. Great experience.
author: William_K

title: It was as expected, this...
text: It was as expected, this was a return visit for us. Our daughter and grand kids loved it. I was glad we did it.
author: Fernando_S

title: Sevilla is a must-see!
text: Sevilla is a beautiful place. The blend of cultures evident in its art and architecture make for a must-see. To understand its history, which is fascinating, book this tour. Our guide and docent, Cristina, was excellent. Not only was she an excellent story-teller, she  provided well informed historical and artistic facts. I highly recommend this tour! (Tour in Spanish)
author: Gelcys_C

title: Fab day exploring and learning about these historical masterpieces
text: Really informative, great descriptions and history and the guide was excellent ( Rosa ).  Split the tours up as they plan makes for a great day.
author: Steven_B
